title: 2.0 release readiness umbrella - clear the gates before cutting 2.0.0
description:
UMBRELLA - the release gate list. There is no pre-release tier in this project (one GitHub-only release flow, see the mpi-release skill), so this card IS the pre-release: what must read clear before /mpi-version-bump stamps the version. Same shape as MPI-450, which did this for 1.4. Like MPI-450 it RE-PARENTS NOTHING - every member keeps its own umbrella (MPI-553, MPI-560, MPI-527, MPI-559). Gate list, not a fold.

RETARGETED 1.5 -> 2.0 on 2026-08-26 at Fabio's request. The next release is 2.0, per docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md's own header: 'the next bump is intended as 2.0 - a major release, and Flows are what makes it one' (Fabio, 2026-08-26). Every 1.5 reference in this card was a version label, never a gate.

WHY IT WAS RETARGETED RATHER THAN DELETED: all seven Gate A cards are UNTOUCHED since this card was written - MPI-507, MPI-515, MPI-527, MPI-522, MPI-523, MPI-516 and MPI-575 are each still todo with an updated_at older than the card. Nothing on the gate list was fixed, so nothing on it went stale. What went stale was the measured snapshot.

SO THE SNAPSHOT IS GONE, NOT REFRESHED. The 2026-08-21 numbers (163 commits, 5 whatIsNew + 0 importantChanges + 7 fixes, 5 flows, 3 doing / 65 todo) were five days old and every one was already wrong - 356 commits now, 25 UNRELEASED bullets, 8 flows in the notes and 9 in the registry, 5 doing / 64 todo. A number in a card rots faster than the card is read. checklist.md ON PICKUP is the re-measure list; do not read counts out of the prose.

THIS CARD DOES NOT NEED 2.0's DATE OR CONTENTS FROZEN TO BE VALID. It is a gate MECHANISM, not a content manifest: 'these must read clear before the bump' holds whether the bump is next week or next quarter, and whether 2.0 ships eight Flows or eighteen.

THE RISK IS IN TWO PLACES. (1) The Flow surface goes from dev-gated to the headline feature in one version - that is what makes this a major. (2) The release pipeline itself - a CI-red build guard and a stale update manifest have sat in todo since the 1.4 close-out.

GATE A must-fix (all five still open, re-verified 2026-08-26): MPI-507 -> MPI-515 (the only card labelled a release BLOCKER by its own text), MPI-522 + MPI-523 (artifacts that lie about themselves), MPI-516 (a destroyed prompt hangs forever - Fabio deferred it TO this release on 2026-08-10), MPI-575 (LTX preview junk frames on foley and extend, two Flows this release headlines). MPI-531 CLEARED 2026-08-21. GATE B must-verify: MPI-559 phase 1 on the Linux box (NOT blocked), both test suites, the engine pin compared against the last tag rather than assumed unchanged. GATE C must-decide: the UNRELEASED claim audit, the Flow list, MPI-515's outcome, macOS, the three toast cards, whether a MAJOR digit owes users a migration note, and a re-adjudication of the four cards excluded back when this was a 1.5. GATE D hygiene: push, commit, overtaken-cards.py, the loose Flow cards, the bump.

ANY GATE A CARD THAT DOES NOT CLEAR BECOMES A KNOWN-ISSUE LINE IN THE NOTES. Silently open is not an option - that is the whole point of this card.

FOUND BY THE RETARGET SWEEP: the notes and the code DISAGREE on the Flow list - UNRELEASED.md says 'Eight to start with' and names eight, while js/data/flowsRegistry.js holds NINE top-level ids, the extra being voice-changer, which no bullet mentions. Ships and gets a bullet, or does not ship and gets gated - Gate C. Also: MPI-567 and MPI-594 have since gone done, so the loose-Flow-card adoption into MPI-560 is down to four (586, 591, 557, 355).

Full gate table with the reasoning per member: brief.md. Tick-list: checklist.md.

ANSWERED BY FABIO 2026-08-26 (two Gate C items closed). WHY MAJOR: Flows make it major on AUDIENCE, not code - no migration or compat note owed. Flows open the app to a user who could not use it before, are extremely simple and straightforward, and will draw a different kind of user; and some of them exist NOWHERE ELSE or only behind proprietary websites. That pair is the release-body angle. THE FLOW LIST IS STILL GROWING - more Flows land before the cut, so the gate is no longer 'freeze the list' but a mechanical reconcile run ONCE immediately before the notes freeze (diff flowsRegistry.js ids against the Flows named in UNRELEASED.md, fix the count sentence). The 8-vs-9 voice-changer drift stays as the worked example, not the answer.
